def transform(grid):
    """Keep cells where both corresponding panels have their shared background."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
                    if len(set(row)) == 1 and
                    row[0] not in {cell for rr, other in enumerate(grid)
                                   if rr != r for cell in other}), None)
    if divider is None:
        raise ValueError("uniform divider row not found")
    top, bottom = grid[:divider], grid[divider + 1:]
    if len(top) != len(bottom) or any(len(row) != w for row in grid):
        raise ValueError("panels must have equal dimensions")
    shared = set(x for row in top for x in row) & set(x for row in bottom for x in row)
    if len(shared) != 1:
        raise ValueError("expected one shared panel color")
    color = next(iter(shared))
    return [[3 if top[r][c] == color and bottom[r][c] == color else color
             for c in range(w)] for r in range(len(top))]
